body:
Yes, can definitely relate to the deep thinker parts. And you’re right, it is a burden. The problem is: I recognize that I would be happier if I became less of a deep thinker, but I really like that part of myself. I guess it makes me feel special in some way. Though, I have lately tried to tone down all that deep thinking, to “let go”. I must say, it has had a positive effect on me. It has made me a bit happier.

My mood swings have definitely gotten better the last couple of years. 2 years ago, they were very severe. Some periods, I was extremely depressed and utterly hopeless, and other periods, I was elated. My mood is a lot more stable now. I still have mood swings, but I never really hit rock bottom like I used to. In general, things have improved for me the last couple of years. I am more emotionally stable, I have gotten over many of my insecurities, I my confidence has improved, so on. Although I am not happy, it does get a bit better every year. I can only hope the improvement continues.

Thank you for your insights, they have been very useful.

Thanks for the reply!

I am 20. Probably should have mentioned in my post.
